filename: Sassy Enduro Manager v0.08.1d (Example Live Schedule) - Dev version use at your peril.xlsx

C3.value: Run test session prior to first stint. Confirm electronics and applications are functioning properly such as FFB, audio, external spotter (crew chief), etc.

C4.value: Are tires and fuel set properly? (confirm with outgoing driver)

C5.value: Are all in-car settings such as brake bias and diffs correct? (confirm with outgoing driver)

C6.value: Do you know who is relieving you and when? If you don’t have this answer, escalate before you get in the car.

C8.value: Are tires and fuel set properly? (confirm with incoming driver)

C9.value: Are all in-car settings correct? (jointly with incoming driver)

C10.value: Wait in car for incoming driver to remove you from the vehicle.

C11.value: Update Actual End time and Actual Laps in the schedule. Actual End time should be when the car hits the track, not just when the car starts moving.

A1.value: Duration of race in hh:mm:ss format.

L5.formula: E5 + if(LEFT(C5, 3) = "std", Overview!$L$4, Overview!$L$5) + Overview!$E$15 + IF(AND(ISERR(FIND("no tires", C5)), Overview!$E$17), Overview!$E$18, "0:00:00")

V5.formula: if(O5, ($F$3 - E5)/(Overview!$H$4 + U5), if(LEFT(C5, 3) = "std", Overview!$J$4, Overview!$J$5))

AK5.formula: IF(ISNA(AJ5), AI5, IF(AI5=AJ5, AI5, IFERROR(AJ5, AI5)))

B3.value:
- Support GMT offsets that include 30 minute increments.
- Adding color coding for columns that are intended to be hidden and never touched.
- Added bright yellow highlight for "Select Driver" values in Schedule tab.
- Adding changelog tab.

B4.value:
- Final stint is now calculated based on race end instead of fuel stint type.
- Replaced open ranges with static ranges where possible.
- Replaced multiple vlookups with helper cells where possible.
- Added gray/strikethru style to over-scheduled stints on Schedule and Driver Availability tabs.
- Added "to be hidden" style to remaining hidden columns/rows
- Calculate rolling/incrementing numbers based on ROW() as an offset instead of chained formulas/expression trees.
- Moved hidden columns in Roster tab to end of the sheet to prevent accidental issues when copy/pasting from another schedule

C4.value: - Realtime deltas in the Overview tab still use all of the stints on the Schedule instead of only stints that are required to reach the end of event. This is not technically a bug as it the intention of the deltas is to provide an at-a-glance view of how many stints you are over or under compared to your originally intended schedule. Need to rethink how to present this information to be more clear.

B5.value:
- Added Race Duration.
- Added Session Start (ToD) to overview and all relevant calculations.
- Added offset between session start and start of the first fuel stint to account for qualifying, grid and outlap delay before beginning calculations for the first fuel stint
- Added automatic show/hide logic for stints based on changes to the GMT start and end time cells in the Overview tab.
- Added "Sassy Config" custom menu to provide a trigger point for custom functionality moving forward.
- Added "Update Driver Colors" feature under "Sassy Config" menu. This will update the Schedule and Driver Availability tab to match colors in the Roster tab. It's also possible to trigger this by adding or removing text in any of the color fields on the roster tab.
- Added "Reset Driver Availability" feature under "Sassy Config" menu.
- Added "Update Stint Visibility" feature under "Sassy Config" menu. Note this automatically fires when session start and end times are updated on the Overview tab. This is provided in case there are dramatic events that have caused stints to become surplus and you'd like to automatically hide them
- Changed protected ranges from no-edits to warning only. This is done to avoid incorrect permissions violations when updating driver colors or resetting availability.
- Fixed "off by one" error in availability calculations that was causing the range inspected to determine availability to be incorrected shifted down one row.
- Tweaked labels and layout of Overview tab.
- Added fuel tank size to Additiona Config section on Overview tab.
- Switched lap calculations to work based on fuel burn.
- Updated Realtime Deltas section on Overview tab to only consider "non-surplus" stints.
- Added final lap fuel calculator
- Removed Scheduled Laps and Scheduled Duration from Realtime Deltas. These were provided to let the owner know they need to add or remove rows from the Schedule tab. This is no longer necessary because the schedule can now detect the final lap and make adjustments automatically.
- Changed Lap Delta on Schedule tab to Actual Laps. This value is defaulted to Calc Laps.
- Added lap time factors for time of day and driver. Factors now applied to Schedule.
- Added lap modifiers to add a time interval to every lap on or after the fuel stint where the modifier is applied.
- Fixed bug with surplus stints being incorrectly handled in various places.
- Added driver name change logic to automatically update assigned driver in the Schedule sheet whenever a driver name is changed in the Roster sheet.

C5.value: - Deployment of AppScript needs a closer look to ensure best practices/mode of least privilege.

B6.value: - Fixed bug with driver availability sheet failing to identify surplus stints

B7.value:
- Added tire change duration.
- Added "no tire" standard and fuel saving stint types.
- Minor layout and label changes to Overview tab.
- Minor style changes.
- Update stint visbility on any change to Overview instead of only session start/end/green flag offset

B8.value:
- Adding driver back-to-back stint count preferences to Roster sheet.
- Adding lookup and comparison of back-to-back driver stint count preferences to Schedule sheet with conditional formatting if the driver's preferences are exceeded.
- Added AVG iRating Calcs tab to show all possible iRatings available upon registration depending on which drivers register before session start.
- Swapping Session Start (ToD) with Race Start (ToD) due to discovery that in-game time is artifically advanced by iRacing. Actual ToD in-session race start is not known until the race session kicks off.
- Adding dynamic calculation of final stint lap count.
- Refactored Total Race Laps in Realtime Deltas to look at calculated and actual laps from the Schedule sheet instead of projecting estimates based on an average standard fuel stint.
- Removed Lap Delta from Misc Calculated Values
- Added Time Lost to Misc Calculated Values.
- Changed GMT offsets used to calculate Driver Localized Times from minutes to durations because they inexplicably stopped calculating.
- Minor formatting to improve label readability.
- Removed "GMT" column from Driver Localized Times. It is unnecessary. GMT Slot is already on the same line in Driver Availability.
- Added "Current GMT" to Fuel Stint Schedule label on the Schedule tab. This updates automatically every minute.
- Fixed average irating calc.

B9.value:
- Applied color coding to remaining driver-centric values on Schedule and Overview sheets.
- Added second stint mapping to timeslots on Driver Availability tab.
- Changed availability detection logic in Schedule tab to consider both possible mapped stints. This prevents incorrect availability reporting when a stint technically ended in the middle of a timeslot.
- Various small usability/visibilty updates such as hiding unnecessary columns, label changes and freezing panes.
- Added fuel stint unassignment for surplus fuel stints when Update Stint Visibility function is called.
- Changed fuel stint descriptions in Schedule tab to be more obvious about tires/no tires.

B10.value:
- Added several named ranges.
- Refactored lookups to driver availability and roster pages to refer to named ranges instead.
- Overhauled status detection to use Query() instead of gigantic nested range lookups.
- Groundwork for infinite drivers now supported. Manual creation/deletion of columns to match driver counts still required.
- Added dev menu to show/hide how the sausage is made. Highly useful for anyone who wants to mod for their own purposes, including me.
- Fixed bug with auto-unassignment of stints that have been determined to be no longer needed sometimes wouldn't update all impacted stints.
- Removed irating calculator as iracing moving to preregistration-only renders this feature useless.
- Removed stints by driver. The Schedule tab shows this plainly enough. No need for another view.
- Color coded localized times in Driver Availability for easier at-a-glance reference.

B11.value:
- Now supporting up to 16 drivers!
- Switched how conditional formatting is manipulated via app script from absolute cell references to named ranges.
- Cleaned up conditional formatting rulesets with erroneous ranges. Replaced duplicate/unnecessary rulesets with appropriate ranges to rulesets still in place
- Changed method for tracking laps from recording actual laps per stint to recording the in-lap instead. Actual laps is now a derived value from in-laps and is no longer user-editable
- Changed header colors for editable columns to goldenrod.
- Fixed driver color updates for stint pie chart.
